phases.name: Static Site Launch
phases.description: Deploy all static HTML/CSS/JS pages to Cloudflare Pages. No backend needed. Donations use external hosted payment links.

items: Replace Formspree placeholder `your-form-id` with real ID — or replace with mailto fallback for now
Fix `newsletter/advertise.html` links pointing to `index.html#subscribe` — remove or comment out
Delete duplicate `gideonabochie-org/images books and socials/` directory
Rename book files to remove spaces (use hyphens)
Compress `logo.png` (2.4MB → ~150KB) — use tinypng.com or squoosh.app
Compress `neogh-logo.png` (1.9MB → ~100KB)
Compress gallery images (550–995KB each → ~200KB each)
Optional: convert logos to WebP for smaller size
Create `_headers` file with CSP, HSTS, CORS headers
Create `_redirects` file for domain redirects (gideonabochie.org → www or vice versa)
Verify all relative paths work from subdirectory if needed
Go to dash.cloudflare.com → Pages → Create → Direct Upload
Upload entire `gideonabochie-org/` folder
Set custom domain: gideonabochie.org
Add CNAME DNS record: gideonabochie.org → gideonabochie.pages.dev
Verify HTTPS is working
Test all pages, links, donation buttons
Fix UTF-8 encoding issues in advertise.html (mojibake characters)
Add prefers-reduced-motion media query to disable scroll animations
Add prefers-color-scheme media query for light mode support
Add touch-action: manipulation to interactive elements
Add loading='lazy' to all below-the-fold images
Ensure consistent font-display strategy across all pages
Add gideonabochie.org to Cloudflare Pages project
Add CNAME DNS record: gideonabochie.org → gideonabochie-org.pages.dev
Wait for SSL cert provisioning (automatic)
Verify domain resolves and HTTPS works
Sign up for Zero Trust Free plan (50 users, email OTP)
Zero Trust dashboard → Access → Applications → Add self-hosted
Domain: gideonabochie.org, Path: admin/*
Policy: Email OTP → authorize info@gideonabochie.com
Verify admin pages are login-gated
teaching-session.jpg (550KB), creative-workshop.jpg, community-outreach.jpg
book-launch.jpg, behind-scenes.jpg, ministry-moment.jpg
Target: ~200KB each via TinyPNG or PowerShell compression
Update src paths if filenames change
Create/download Flutterwave donation decal PDF
Place in assets/ as flutterwave-decal.pdf
Add download link on landing page (index.html footer or give section)

acceptance_criteria: All pages load via https://gideonabochie.org
Nav links work on all pages
Donation buttons (Flutterwave, Ko-fi, BMC) open correct payment pages
Social links (X, Facebook, TikTok, Instagram) resolve correctly
Books are downloadable
Legal pages are accessible
Lead form submits (or gracefully falls back)
All pages pass Lighthouse Mobile score ≥ 80
Animations respect prefers-reduced-motion
No 300ms tap delay on interactive elements

phases.name: Serverless Functions & Engagement
phases.description: Add Cloudflare Workers for form handling, newsletter subscription, news aggregation proxy, and ad booking.

items: Create Cloudflare Worker for form submissions (lead capture, contact)
Worker stores submissions in Cloudflare KV or emails them
Remove Formspree dependency — go self-hosted on Workers
Add honeypot + rate limiting for spam protection
Add subscribe form section to `newsletter/index.html` (with #subscribe anchor)
Worker handles email capture — stores in KV or sends to email
Fix advertise.html links pointing to #subscribe
Optional: integrate with ConvertKit / Mailchimp later
Replace rss2json.com free tier with a Cloudflare Worker
Worker fetches + caches RSS feeds from Ghana news sources
Add caching headers to stay within free tier limits
Replace mailto: links on advertise.html with a booking form
Worker processes ad inquiries and notifies admin
Add rate card PDF download option

acceptance_criteria: Form submissions work without Formspree
Newsletter subscribe captures emails
News aggregator works reliably under traffic
Ad inquiries submit without exposing raw email

phases.name: Backend + Database
phases.description: Deploy GAHQ CRM backend to a server with a proper database. Connect static site to backend APIs for dynamic features.
phases.platform: Railway / Fly.io / VPS (paid ~$5-20/mo) + Cloudflare DNS + Postgres/SQLite

items: Choose platform: Railway (simplest), Fly.io, or a $5 VPS
Deploy FastAPI backend from `backend/crm/`
Set up database (Postgres on Railway or SQLite on VPS)
Configure environment variables (API keys, DB URL)
Set up CI/CD from GitHub repo
Connect Flutterwave webhook to log donations in database
Build simple donation dashboard (admin-only)
Set up email notification on new donation
Build admin panel for updating newsletter content
Add ability to manage testimonials, stats, gallery from admin
Replace hardcoded static data with API-driven content

acceptance_criteria: Backend APIs accessible via API.gideonabochie.org (subdomain)
Donations logged in database
Admin can update content without editing HTML
Forms submit to backend, not external services

phases.platform: Cloudflare Pages + Backend VPS + Third-party APIs

items: Accept ad payments via Flutterwave directly on site
Automated ad slot calendar and booking confirmation
Rate card PDF generator
Welcome sequence for newsletter subscribers
Automated follow-up for manifestos downloaders
Donation thank-you sequences
Page view analytics (Cloudflare Web Analytics — free)
Donation funnel tracking
Newsletter growth dashboard
Ad revenue reporting
Members-only book chapters
Exclusive video teachings behind email gate
Paid courses or workshops

acceptance_criteria: Site generates revenue beyond donations (ads, subscriptions)
Admin has full visibility into all metrics
Automated email sequences run without manual intervention

current_focus: Phase 1 — remaining deployment tasks: custom domain, Cloudflare Access, image compression, decal PDF
notes: Cloudflare Pages is the right starting point — free, fast global CDN, easy HTTPS.
Phases 2-4 build on the same Cloudflare infrastructure using Workers and a backend.
The GAHQ CRM backend already exists locally — deploying it is the main Phase 3 effort.
Don't wait for perfect — deploy Phase 1 now, iterate live.
Roadmap now has auto-verification: checks live files on load, auto-marks done items.
Refactored to industry-standard structure: assets/css/main.css + assets/js/main.js.
404.html added. Gallery images renamed. Roadmap moved to /admin/.
RSS news proxy (Pages Function) replaces rss2json.com — live Ghana news feed.
Books converted to lead magnets (email capture modal via Formspree).
Sales chat widget with animated dice mascot added to donation page.
Mobile UX polish (step 1.9) should be completed before Phase 2 — users judge the site on mobile first.
Remaining: custom domain, Cloudflare Access, image compression, decal PDF.
